prompt: What is the most recent film to join the top 10 highest-grossing films of all time?
answer: **_Spider-Man: Brand New Day_ (2026)** is the most recent film to join the all-time worldwide top 10. It is listed at **No. 3**, with approximately **$2.52 billion** worldwide. Although **_The Odyssey_ (2026)** is newer, it ranks just outside the top 10 at No. 11.
